verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents its own natural-language interfaces: users create Agents in the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language, can reply to a paused run so it continues, and Stagehand offers natural-language selectors for browser actions. Coverage is not complete, because the evidence shows natural-language control of agent tasks and browser actions, not of the product overall. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of platform operations such as session, settings and webhook management; independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
